verdict.rationale: Freshsales includes a built-in AI, Freddy AI, that marketing docs say handles some delegated work: writing emails, plus capturing, qualifying and routing leads alongside scoring and deal recommendations. Nothing shows an assistant interface where a user can hand over arbitrary tasks on request. Missing for 10: a documented conversational assistant that accepts user-delegated tasks, details on which actions it can take autonomously, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: highlighting the best leads and deals, offering insights, and even writing emails.
capture, qualify, route, and track them with the power of Freddy AI.
Avoid bottlenecks and plan accurately with deal recommendations by Freddy AI.
